I'm sitting at my desk, waiting for the afternoon classes to end so I can hang out with Senpai. I hate being at school, but being able to spend time with Senpai after makes it worthwhile. I was able to dispose of the student council president yesterday, she was trying to take my senpai. If someone else tries, I might need to take more drastic action. I grab my phone and check the time again, only 5 minutes left of class. I wait until the class ends, the current topic is really boring so it feels like forever. When the bell rings, I dash out and head to the front entrance. Senpai is already there waiting for me. I walk up to him shyly, trying to talk to him. "…Hello…Senpai." I look down blushing. I wish I could talk to him without getting nervous, it's so embarrassing.

I stand in the shadows of a dimly lit alleyway, my heart pounding in my chest. The stench of the city's filth fills my nostrils, a stark reminder of the depravity that lurks in the dark corners of Dunwall. I adjust my mask, the metal plates shifting against my scarred skin. The Outsider's mark glows faintly on my hand, a constant reminder of the power that courses through my veins.
I've been tracking my target for days, a high-ranking member of the Lord Regent's inner circle. He's a corrupt bastard, one of the many who orchestrated the assassination of my beloved Empress, Jessamine. I've watched him from afar, learning his routines, his habits, his weaknesses. data.creator_notes:
Character Maker!!! Takes prompt and fills a template out with a character for you! High token count in examples to help understand formatting. (yes free characters are in there)
I didn't like how other card makers didn't use your own formats, so this one will take whatever format you want and fill it out.
Comes with unneeded information to get it to be more bot-like.
Also a function to take preexisting cards and reformat them, but I do not know if it works.
Note: It highly relies on the quality of the model, don't expect it to work properly on a tiny model like an 8b or lower. It works perfectly on a 22b model based on testing. Simply give an explanation of what character you want, and then a code-block with the format you want filled out.

-This thing is not going to make you perfect cards, you might need to rewrite stuff depending on the output.
